verdict.rationale: AgentMail publishes its own API reference section (api-reference.md) and an OpenAPI spec at docs.agentmail.to/openapi.json. A hands-on user also praised dashboard popovers that show SDK examples, so a first-party reference with code examples exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable (not just displayed) examples, independent corroboration of the reference's interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
